scope: Main tall tower source; observatory candidate remains incomplete.

publishedDimensions.finding: 3 by 3 m ground section;325 m structure;331 m including lightning conductor;1500 steps. Main-tower location is S2°08′45.13″ W59°00′20.12″, attributed by the publication to Google Maps.
Field measurement and subsequent tower drawing establish a321 m top platform,324 m gas inlets and331 m tip. Foundation height above nearby ground varies; no universal terrain datum is inferred.

RoLi rail is on the southern corner at202° azimuth. Six guy attachment heights;6 m main rail segments;3 m brackets;4 m power rails at128 mm offset;40 mm frame extrusions. Figure1 CAD and Figure2 photographs were visually inspected.

inspectedImages.finding: Square shaft, bolted angle chords and X bracing, internal stairs, alternating red/white sections and top platform with outriggers. Platform width and band boundaries are proportional readings.
Top elevation drawing, lightning-rod head, base grating and top inlet caps inspected in the browser. No image files redistributed.
